newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo declines comment on Lonrho report.
newsitem.headline: Anglo declines comment on Lonrho report.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday it had no comment on a newspaper report that the firm had declined to exercise an option to give it a 25.7 percent stake in British group Lonrho PLc.
"We do not comment on market speculation," an Anglo spokeswoman said.
Anglo, which already owns a 7.3 percent of Lonrho, earlier this year bought the purchase rights over another 18.4 percent held by Lonrho's chief executive Dieter Bock.

The London Evening Standard report said Anglo's enthusiasm had cooled off after being told by the Ghanaian government it would not allow the South African firm to take control over Ashanti Goldfields, in which Lonrho has a stake of about 30 percent.
But a Lonrho spokesman said there was no foundation in the report and a source close to Anglo also dismissed the story. "It is a bit of rubbish," the source said.
